title: lindsaea orbiculata var. recedens
intro: Lindsaea orbiculata var. recedens, commonly known as a species of the Lindsaea genus, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Lindsaeaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lindsaea orbiculata var. recedens include its potential to act as an antihypertensive and lipid-lowering agent, due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
